pages.text: $(bold)Ancient Sanctuary$() (default armor trait of Pyrium, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effect:$(li)permanent $(bold)5% damage reduction$() that $(bold)stacks per worn piece$(): 5% at one, about 9.8% at two and $(bold)18.5%$() at four (chained multiplication)$(li)while wearing $(bold)any$() piece with this trait, $(bold)Fire-school spell power +25%$() (a flat bonus, not per piece)$(br2)The reduction applies after armor and absorption, closest to the final damage.
